description: Officials say the pilot is aimed at assessing the accuracy, tech feasibility and scalability before any decision is taken on wider deployment.
body_lead: Synopsis: Andhra Pradesh is piloting AI-powered diagnostic tools across 18 government hospitals to improve early disease detection. Innovations include cough-based TB screening, smartphone cataract imaging, and non-invasive anaemia testing. Officials say faster, portable diagnostics can strengthen primary healthcare, reduce delays, and expand access, with results guiding wider integration into the state’s public health system. A woman sits on the steps outside a Primary Health Centre in Chagallu and coughs into a mobile phone as health workers watch closely. The phone is not recording a call.
